segments.contextBefore: The following example configures a `confirmationDialog` with a suppression toggle.

segments.normalizedSource: ```swift struct ConfirmEraseItems: View { @State private var isShowingDialog = false @AppStorage("suppressEraseItemAlert") private var suppressAlert = false var body: some View { Button("Delete Items") { if !suppressAlert { isShowingDialog = true } else { // Handle item deletion. } } .confirmationDialog( "Are you sure you want to erase these items?", isPresented: $isShowingDialog ) { Button("Erase", role: .destructive) { // Handle item deletion. } Button("Cancel", role: .cancel) { isShowingDialog = false } } .dialogSuppressionToggle( "Do not ask about erasing items again", isSuppressed: $suppressAlert) } } ```
